thought.text: IP-nya berubah tiap request — belum sticky. Saya coba parameter lain untuk mengunci sesi.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && T="stk$(date +%s)"; echo "=== coba format session berbeda ==="; for U in "ResiFactory_1840e2833~id~$T" "ResiFactory_1840e2833~id~$T-session" "ResiFactory_1840e2833~id~$T~sticky" "ResiFactory_1840e2833~id~$T-sessid-$T"; do echo "user: $U"; for i in 1 2; do printf "   %d: " $i; curl -s --max-time 35 -x "http://$U:TPbfq2zsdVHz@premium.resifactory.net:7777" "https://ipinfo.io/ip" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n'; echo; done; done
